rationale: The 27 April 1942 Evening Star item identifies a Florence Cornell only as chief registrar at Adams School. A later Washington Post obituary identifies that school official as Florence Newell Cornell and documents a District of Columbia education career through 1959, but neither source supplies the indexed middle initial, Box 145, a private identifier, an OSS connection, or another unique bridge. No school-system affiliation is transferred to the indexed Florence Cornell.
